# use-geography

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse geography set.

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-geography/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-geography/

- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-geography/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-geography/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-geography/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
